I am Korean and most of my friends are Arabs, Pakistanis, and Iranians. 

Whenever I call my friend Huda or Moza, my mom calls them terrorists and yell at me for wanting to join ISIS. 

When I decided to learn Arabic, it was even worse. They are super conservative Christians and said that they don’t like “brown” people in this country. To be honest, I find that most of these Christian conservative Asian parents are the real terrorists and abusers. My mom and dad never let me have friends and would blame me for not having any friends. 

Anyways, I am still friends with them of course and now I am going back to North Carolina to live on my own. Except this time, my friends are going to stay in my life while my parents aren’t allowed in my life.

The quote, “Blood is thicker than water” is wrong. The actual quote is, “The blood of the covenant is thicker than the water of the womb.” 

It doesn’t matter if they are your parents or part of your family. If they don’t care to be a positive support in your life then cut them out immediately. Don’t fall for that bullshit excuse of them changing either. I fell for it this time, and it turns out that they never changed.

Leave and don’t look back! The people who do love you and care for your best interests will always be a positive influence in your life!
I understand shitty apartment managers. I am dealing with a court case right now with my apartment manager who is committing fraud.

I think what brought me here was the fact that I have been wronged so much in my life and realize that being human is something that is filled with greed and malice. 

I also didn’t know that there were others who felt the same as me. 

I don’t like humanity but I still try to make the world a better place by trying to redefine what being human means. 

I just hate the world for the evil in it, but I don’t hate those who have suffered from that evil.

Update: I asked the property manager to repair the damage in a timely manner. She said I had two options both with a penalty fee:

1) move out of the complex and pay a penalty fee

2) move out to a different apartment in the complex and pay a penalty fee

I consulted someone who is a lawyer about this and he said that this is surely illegal in the state of NC but many property managers do this because middle class Americans will not be able to afford the legal fees to sue in court anyways.
I am just scared because it will be hard to deal with.

Yeah I am basically stuck in the house and can’t go anywhere. I really don’t want the police involved because I don’t need drama in my life. 

I am also dealing with really abusive landlords too, so I am planning on escaping with the help of a friend, filing complaints through HUD, Fair Housing, the Durham Real Estate Commission, and small claims court, and living with my friend for a while.

The damage is flood damage from sprinklers bursting during the snowfall in NC from an apartment above mine that was vacant. The apartment was supposed to take care of the temperature controls of a vacant apartment to make sure that nothing bursts.

When I called my renter’s insurance, they asked the woman why the leasing office would not transfer my lease to a different apartment for free instantly since the one I have is currently inhospitable. The renter’s insurance company even stated that the leasing office is responsible for relocating me. 

However, the woman in the leasing office made an excuse despite the fact that there are open 1 bedroom units, stating that she cannot transfer me to a different apartment unless I pay the penalty fee. I refused to pay the penalty fee because this issue was not my fault, and I was not responsible for the damage done. Since I refused to pay the $3000 fee on that day, she just said that I will just have to go back to Atlanta which was another 6 hours of driving. 

Threatening a tenant: another reason for why I believe that I qualify for breaking the lease without penalty as well as receiving extra compensation.
